# Installation configuration parameters for {{ ibm_power_server_title }} {#installation-config-parameters-ibm-power-vs}

Before you deploy an OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ ibm_power_server_name }}, you supply parameters to customize your cluster and the platform that hosts it.

When you create the `install-config.yaml` file, you provide values for the required parameters through the command line. You can then modify the `install-config.yaml` file to customize your cluster further.
